properties.notes: Allocation CR11e in Local Plan. Permission 110024 was for up to 434 dwellings, retail, hotel, offices on part of site, but has now expired. There will be retail and leisure development on the ground floor activating the streets and spaces including the new northern station square, with other uses including residential and offices on upper floors. Retail will have good pedestrian links to, and will not have a detrimental impact on, the rest of the retail core of the centre.
